description_en: Creates a read-only shard account for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance with cloud disks
description_zh: 创建MongoDB云盘版分片集群实例的Shard只读账号
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-account --db-instance-id dds-uf6e9433e955xxxx --account-name admin1 --account-password 'Test123456!' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.help_en: The account name. The name must be 4 to 16 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). It must start with a lowercase letter. The account has read-only permissions
parameters.help_zh: 账号名。由小写字母、数字或下划线组成，以小写字母开头，长度为4~16个字符。权限为只读
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The account password. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =

For information about how to handle special characters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.help_zh:
账户密码。
大写、小写、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为8~32个字符；特殊字符为 ! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =

特殊字符的处理方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/471568.html
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en:
The type of the account to be created. Valid values:
db: shard account. This is the default value.
cs: Configserver account.
normal: replica set account.

Currently, only db accounts are supported
parameters.help_zh:
创建账号类型。取值：
db: 默认值，shard账号（仅支持）
cs：config server账号
normal：副本集账号

当前仅支持创建DB账号
parameters.name: character_type

parameters.help_en: The list of authorized roles for the account
parameters.name: roles

parameters.help_en: The database to which the account belongs. This is the database where the account is created or on which the account operates. Default value: admin. The name must be 1 to 63 characters in length and cannot contain /, \, ., spaces, double quotation marks ("), or $. The name cannot be local
parameters.help_zh: 账号所在库（账号建在/操作于哪个库），缺省 admin；规则：长度1~63，禁 /、\、.、空格、"、$，禁 local
parameters.name: db_name
